For the first part, we need to convert Western note C to Indian classical note. The user didn't specify which C (maybe middle C). In Western, middle C is about 261.63 Hz. But they gave 440 Hz, which is A4. They want to convert 440 Hz to wavelength. So we need to use the function frequency_to_wavelength. Also we need to convert note C to Indian classical note using note_conversion_indian. But we need to provide the note name. Which C? Probably middle C (C4). But we can mention that it's about 261.63 Hz. But the user didn't give the frequency for C. We can assume middle C. So we need to call note_conversion_indian with note "C". Then call frequency_to_wavelength with frequency 440. We'll produce the outputs.
